digest.component_or_area: semantic capability registry and optional dependency enforcement
propositions: A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must independently track 14 immutable records mapping semantic keys to packaging extras and missing postures without importing probe modules
Stable verbs and top-level help must remain executable in a no-extras wheel while only the selected execution boundary emits actionable errors for error-posture capabilities
Lean diagnostic and read-only modes must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities, such as audit show without audit_ui or non-agent review/workflow paths without agent_runtime
Unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures must preserve existing domain-controlled result payloads and exception contracts rather than manufacturing errors in the registry
Separate entry points mcp_server and review_bot must consume capability metadata without registering as CLI routes or appearing in the top-level command registry
